exceptions.rationale: No patched release exists. Expo/Metro requires micromatch, and the supported Tailwind 3 toolchain requires chokidar; both require braces. Replacing either build toolchain would change the supported Expo and NativeWind setup.
exceptions.scope: Development and build tooling only: Expo/Metro file mapping and Tailwind pattern watching; not imported by app runtime source.
exceptions.reviewCondition: Review immediately when braces, micromatch, Expo/Metro, or the affected Tailwind toolchain publishes a safe replacement; CI fails on any newer braces release or fixed advisory range.

exceptions.rationale: No patched release exists. The archive privacy evidence verifier parses PKCS#7 data with node-forge, and the supported Expo CLI and certificate package still require it. Replacing only the direct verifier use would leave both Expo paths.
exceptions.scope: Development, CI, archive evidence, and Expo certificate tooling only; not imported by app runtime source.
exceptions.reviewCondition: Review immediately when node-forge or the Expo certificate toolchain publishes a safe replacement; CI fails on any newer node-forge release or fixed advisory range.
